summary: Surf Air Mobility Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a registered direct offering closed April 21, 2026. The company sold 13,318,181 shares to an existing investor and another institutional investor at $1.10/share, plus 257,353 shares to directors/officers at $1.36/share (the NYSE closing price on April 17). Gross proceeds were about $15 million. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acted as financial advisor. The offering was conducted under an existing shelf registration statement (Form S-3, File No. 333-291485). A 30-day restricted period prohibits further equity issuances. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
